asphalt_street.notes: Worn street asphalt (real 4 m scan scale), strictly neutral warm grey (OKLab a ~0, b slightly +; r1 CUL06/WD15 measured a teal cast in capture, which is lighting, not this map). Tar seals / patches / oil / manhole are the decal_tar, decal_patch, decal_oil_tile, manhole_iron sets.

bark.notes: Generic deciduous tree bark (backyard trees, dead desert trees).

brass.notes: Aged brass (fixtures, door hardware, stair rods, chandelier): fine scratches and smudges from a CC0 metal scan, satin.

brick_dark.notes: Dark clinker brick for the yellow-backyard BBQ/planter and the welcome-sign base.

brick_red.notes: Chimney / column common brick, running bond (~65 mm courses). Green-house chimney, deck column.

car_paint.notes: Clean 1950s enamel: orange-peel normal, light dust (A=0 in dust so the tint stays on paint). Use with clearcoat.

car_paint_worn.notes: Weathered body paint with rust spots (A = paint mask). Wrecks, truck cab, trailer skirts.

carpet.notes: Cut-and-loop pile wall-to-wall carpet (GI06): CC0 tuft scan for the fine pile, a procedural 8.5 mm tufted-row weave, heather flecks and pile clumps that read at 2-4 m, row normal (0.5 m tile). Traffic wear is the _macro (kind carpet: soft matted trails and patches at 6 m). Neutral light base, fully tintable.

carpet_lowpile.notes: Low-pile (commercial loop) carpet for the back rooms (grey-green, YI14 / GI04): finer 5.5 mm rows, tighter heather, flatter pile. Neutral light base, fully tintable.

chain.notes: Swing-set chain card: 4 welded links (35 mm) per tile vertically, chain centred in U (card ~0.04 m wide => use U 0.375..0.625).

chainlink.notes: Galvanized chain-link mesh (~50 mm diamonds), alpha-tested. Wires pre-thickened (~3 mm) so mip coverage survives; use alphaToCoverage with MSAA. Perimeter / tower fence.

chrome.notes: Bumpers, grilles, hubcaps, trim: chrome with fine scratches and smudges (F0 ~0.55).

cmu_white.notes: Whitewashed concrete block, 8x16 in (203 x 406 mm) running bond, tooled 9.5 mm joints in the normal + AO; pores from a CC0 concrete scan. Yellow garage walls (YI12).

concrete_cast.notes: Cast concrete: foundations, fallout-shelter walls, steps, sign footings.

counter_laminate.notes: 1950s boomerang laminate countertop / dinette table top — original pattern (this repo, CC0) on a CC0 plastic scan. Semi-gloss.

curb_concrete.notes: Cast curb concrete (CUL04): light grey #979581-in-capture fine aggregate, low contrast (no sandy speckle, no debris blotches). The dark sidewalk joint and the gutter flow line are GROUND's geometry.

dash_plastic.notes: Textured dashboard / bakelite trim plastic, tintable (body colour or ivory).

decal_asphalt_cracks.notes: Atlas of asphalt cracks / spalls / tar-patch pieces (~2 m across the atlas). Place over asphalt_street.

decal_grime_base.notes: Splash-back grime rising from the ground: bottoms of siding, fences, sheds, curbs.

decal_leak_streaks.notes: Dirt run-off streaks hanging from a top edge: under windowsills, eaves, AC units, gutters.

decal_manhole.notes: Round cast-iron manhole cover (0.8 m) in the street (BO1 cul-de-sac).

decal_oil.notes: 2x2 atlas of oil / drip stains (~1.2 m each, original procedural). Driveways, under vehicles, garage floors. ORM.G lowers roughness (glossy oil).

decal_oil_tile.notes: WORLD-TILING oil blots: one irregular drip stain + satellites per 2.4 m tile, alpha 0 within 10% of every tile border, glossy. A quad snapped to the 2.4 m world grid (x0, z0 multiples of 2.4) shows whole stains; any quad shows only soft-edged stain parts, never a cut straight edge where alpha > 0 (keep quads ≥ 2.4 m or grid-aligned).

decal_patch.notes: Patched asphalt (CUL10): a second CC0 asphalt scan at the base asphalt's 4 m aggregate scale, darker and smoother. Irregular feathered edge + tar-seam outline come from COLOR_0 coverage (Spec.dfade / under: nt_asphalt).

decal_roadline.notes: Worn white road-paint stripe (~120 mm wide), tiles along V. Stop bars / edge lines on the cul-de-sac exit.

decal_tar.notes: Crack-seal tar, FLAT (CUL02 / SO19): #34342e, normal flat, roughness ~0.5 (satin, no glint), feathered alpha. As a world-tiling 4 m network for rect windows; GROUND's thin polylines take solid coverage from COLOR_0 (Spec.dfade). Original procedural.

deck_boards.notes: Stained porch / deck decking with gaps (yellow-house deck, stairs, balcony, pergola timbers).

deck_pine.notes: Honey pine / cedar deck boards (both rear decks, stairs, ground deck; GE10 / YE09 / YD08): 140 mm boards along U with soft 5 mm gaps, random butt joints, chamfers, per-board tone, light grey traffic wear down the board centres, nail pairs at 0.4 m joists. Sunlit target #d0a874-#d9b07a. Diagonal planks = Spec.rot 45. CC0 grain scan.

desert_ground.notes: Nevada desert scrubland floor beyond the fence (pale tan, pebbles). Use macro at 40 m + distance fog; scrub bushes are props.

dirt_packed.notes: Packed brown side-yard dirt (CC0 dry-ground scan, cracks and pebbles toned down), faint footprint trails and drag marks pressed into the normal and slightly darker/smoother. Albedo ~#8a7058 reads ~#987d62 lit.

dirt_yard.notes: Packed reddish-brown dirt with small stones: green-house garage side yard, flower beds, embankments.

door_paint.notes: Brushed exterior door paint over wood (front/back doors, shed X-brace doors, shutters). Panels are geometry; this is the surface.

driveway_concrete.notes: Broom-finished concrete (patio, driveways, aprons; GE12): fine-aggregate CC0 scan, broom striations along U, a tooled joint on the 3 m tile edges; no trowel swirl, no stains. Bible slabs ~#ada993.

fabric_weave.notes: Woven drapery cloth (CC0 scan), neutral light base, tintable: navy drapes #1f2f5a, gold drapes. Folds are geometry.

fence_board.notes: Raw cedar privacy-fence BOARD SURFACE for GROUND's modelled zero-gap boards (YD03): albedo ~#a88560 (sun ~#c09a70, shade ~#5a483c), vertical grain low-passed (no moiré), faint weather streaks, sparse knots with a resin ring, nail heads on the rail line (tile 1.1 m = the 0.35 / 1.45 m rail spacing). Per-board tint (COLOR_0.r), the seam groove (COLOR_0.g) and the grey base weathering / soil splash are the shader's (nuketown-specs). CC0 grain scan.

fence_privacy.notes: SketchUp slab fences only: 8 painted boards per 1.12 m tile with 10 mm soft gaps (was 3 mm: the r1 WD11 moiré), wide bevel, low-passed grain normal. Same palette as fence_board (albedo ~#8a7058).

floor_checker_caramel.notes: Cream / caramel 30 cm vinyl checker (BO1 yellow kitchen, ref bo1-interior-kitchen-01; YI08): class means #e4cd97 / #bc9063, faint jaspé, scuffs, heel marks, seam groove. Fully procedural (this repo, CC0).

floor_hardwood.notes: Oak strip hardwood floor (living rooms, bedrooms, upstairs).

floor_oak.notes: Period oak strip floor: 80 mm boards running along U with random-length butt joints, amber varnish (satin), thin dark seams; boards cut from a CC0 oak scan. Not a modern multi-strip laminate.

garage_door.notes: World-tiling sectional steel door: 4 x 610 mm sections per 2.44 m with dark tongue joints and two raised horizontal panels each (no stiles, so it tiles under the world-metre UV0). Clean paint, fully tintable; no rust.

glass_cracks.notes: Fracture overlay for nt_glass_broken: A = crack/crush coverage (3 impact stars per metre tile), RGB = bright fracture edge. Original procedural.

glass_dust.notes: Window-glass dust film overlay: near-uniform light dust (a ~0.17 +- 0.07 at metre scale), no smears or streaks (YE10). Original procedural.

glass_grime.notes: Window-glass grime overlay: RGB = dust colour, A = grime amount. Shader: glassColor = mix(glassColor, rgb, A*0.8); roughness = mix(0.05, orm.g, A). Map 1 tile per ~1.2 m of glass, offset per window.

grass_cards.notes: 2x2 atlas of grass-blade tufts (one card = 0.32 m square, base on the cell's bottom edge). r2: blade bases start at the LAWN colour (x0.82), not a dark pit, so tufts blend into the turf from above (YD10 / WD11 dark rectangular blotches). Original procedural (this repo, CC0).

grass_dry.notes: Dry / patchy lawn with dirt showing: lawn edges, side yards, under hedges, the transition to desert.

grass_lawn.notes: Irrigated turf (CC0 Grass004) with a high-passed, finer blade normal, lower blade contrast, clover patches (bluer, a few white heads). Low-contrast macro at 12 m (+ Spec macro2 / hue at ~30 m). The r2 'dark blotches' were the near-camera tufts: see grass_cards.

gravel.notes: Loose gravel: service paths, pole bases, tower footing, sandbox surround.

gutter_concrete.notes: Dirtier gutter pan / drain apron concrete between asphalt and curb.

hedge_cards.notes: 2x2 atlas of alpha-tested boxwood cluster cards (~0.25 m each). Scatter on hedge/shrub silhouettes, normals bent outward. Same palette as hedge_leaves.

hedge_leaves.notes: Seamless boxwood leaf mass (scattered CC0 boxwood sprigs, depth-shaded) for clipped hedge box faces. Use with hedge_cards on the silhouette. Albedo is front-lit; add wrap/translucency in the shader (sheen or thin transmission).

joist_pine.notes: Raw (unstained) pine: joists, plywood decking, garage framing (YI13 #b89a6a). Grain along U. CC0 straight-grain scan.

lattice_diamond.notes: White diagonal garden lattice, alpha cutout: 38 mm slats at ±45° on an 88 mm pitch, top layer over bottom layer (height + occlusion). Tile = 4 diagonal periods.

lino_checker.notes: Blue-grey / grey-cream 12 in vinyl checker (4x4 per tile) per the BO1 kitchen (bo1-materials-kitchen-checkerfloor-crop-01): class means #43508a / #acb9ae (cooled so they read #3e4560 / #a9ad99 under the warm 2700 K interior light), jaspé streaks alternating per tile, scratches (light on the dark tiles), traffic scuffs in roughness, thin dark seams. Fully procedural (this repo, CC0).

manhole_iron.notes: Cast-iron cover surface: raised square bosses with a bead ring (4x4 per 25 cm), worn bright tops, rust-dark grooves, metallic ~0.6. Tiles on any disc: model the cover as a 0.8 m disc + rim ring, this is its face.

metal_galvanized.notes: Spangled hot-dip galvanized steel: test/clock towers, light poles, chain-link posts, swing-set frame (tint), mailbox posts.

metal_painted.notes: Painted steel with chips and rust (fallout-shelter door, swing set, sign boxes, mailboxes). A = paint mask; rust/primer stays untinted.

oak_tread.notes: Honey-oak stair treads / stringers (yellow open stair, YI06 / YI07): varnished oak, albedo ~#8a5a30, grain along U. CC0 oak scan.

osb.notes: Raw OSB sheathing (green garage walls / ceilings), pale tan-grey (GI04: #8a7a5c, not orange), 4 ft panel seam + nail rows on the tile edges. CC0 strand-board scan.

paver_concrete.notes: Precast concrete paver top, fine exposed aggregate (CC0 Concrete040, real 1.4 m scale), no joints (the 45 cm pavers are modelled). Stepping-stone path, patios.

picket_paint.notes: White picket paint over pine (SO17): brush film, a faint grain normal through the paint, sparse clustered chips to grey wood (A = 0: the tint skips them). Base grime is the Spec's world-space grime. CC0 scans.

pine_timber.notes: Planed honey pine framing (posts, beams, rails, rafters, stringers, balusters, rims) in the deck_pine tone, faint grey weathering, no board gaps; grain along U (posts use Spec.rot). CC0 grain scan.

plaster_wall.notes: Painted interior plaster wall, fully tintable (yellow living room, teal/yellow kitchen, green-beige bedroom).

roof_roll.notes: Mineral-surfaced roll roofing (green porch roof, GE19): 864 mm exposure courses along U with a lap step and drip shadow, granule surface, streaky weathering; weathered grey ~#788080, no shingle tabs. Procedural (this repo, CC0) on a CC0 granule scan.

roof_shingle_green.notes: Lighter grey-green 3-tab variant for the ranch houses / garages. Same layout as roof_shingle_grey.

roof_shingle_grey.notes: 3-tab asphalt shingles, weathered grey (bible ~#788080, GE19): a 3.66 m tile (28 courses x 12 tabs: half the r1 repeats at range), per-tab tone, granule scan, algae / soot streaks and wind-scrub blotches; macro staining at 13 m (+ Spec macro2). Procedural layout (this repo, CC0) on a CC0 granule scan.

rope.notes: Twisted manila rope (tire swing, flagpole halyard). U along the rope, one tile = 100 mm of rope / one turn around a ~30 mm rope.

rust_metal.notes: Rusted steel (wreck panels, drums, tower bolts).

sapling_leaves.notes: 2x2 atlas of sapling leaf sprigs (SO03): a thin twig with 9-15 CC0 beech leaves per cell (~0.4 m sprig), soft alpha, nothing within 3 % of a cell border (no visible card edges), mean #7f9650 (#6f8a45-#9aa865). For GROUND's foliage_kit.sapling (nt_sapling_leaf).

scrub_sage.notes: 2x2 atlas of desert scrub, 4 species (WD05): big sagebrush (sage-grey #8a8a6a), rabbitbrush (yellow-green, yellow flower tufts), saltbush (blue-grey), a dry dead-twig bush; branch-structured, see-through silhouettes. One card = 1.2 m square, base on the cell's bottom edge. Original procedural (this repo, CC0). For LIGHT's backdrop (nt_scrub_card).

shrub_cards.notes: 2x2 atlas of planter shrub clumps (GE04): three dusty grey-green lavender clumps with purple flower spikes (one sparse, one dense) and a boxwood clump; one card = 0.5 m square, base on the cell's bottom edge, open stem silhouettes. Original procedural (this repo, CC0). For GROUND's planters / foliage_kit.shrub_clump (nt_shrub_card).

sidewalk_concrete.notes: Pale sidewalk slabs: tooled control joints every 1.5 m (2x2 slabs per 3 m tile), cut deeper and darker than r0 with small chipped spalls along the joints (CUL08), smooth trowelled margins, per-slab tone. LOOK BIBLE slabs ~#ada993.

siding_board.notes: Board-and-batten (procedural, this repo, on a CC0 paint-film scan): 305 mm boards, 64 mm battens 19 mm proud with eased edges, faint centre V on each board. _orm.R = occlusion fillet along both batten bases (the 5 m shadow line). Clean near-white base, fully tintable; no stains.

siding_lap.notes: Painted clapboard (procedural, this repo, on a CC0 paint-film scan): 16 courses x 150 mm per 2.4 m, image-up = world-up (the client flips V). Wedge boards (butt 19 mm, top 5 mm), eased butt; _orm.R = 2.5 cm drop-shadow/occlusion band under every butt (Spec.cavity multiplies it into the albedo). Clean near-white base, whole surface tintable; no knots, seams or stains.

soffit_beadboard.notes: White painted 4" beadboard soffit (12 boards per 4 ft), V joints + centre bead along U. Use Spec.facing so the grooves only show on down-facing soffit faces (plain paint on fascia).

soil_bed.notes: Dark, rich flower-bed / planter soil with bark-mulch crumbs (CC0 Ground048). Planter tops, flower beds.

stone_field.notes: Irregular fieldstone feature wall with dark mortar (interior stone wall, garage stone wall).

stone_field_grey.notes: Grey irregular fieldstone with PALE mortar (BO1 yellow-house interior accent walls / passage, refs bo1-interior-stonewall-room-01, bo1-yellowhouse-frontdoor-01; YI09): relaxed-Voronoi flat stones 25-50 cm with chipped arrises and a CC0 rock-scan face, per-stone grey tone, ~2 cm recessed light mortar (deep normal + AO). Average ~#7a7466. Procedural layout (this repo, CC0).

stone_ledge.notes: Stacked ledgestone / fieldstone veneer (green base + planters, yellow spine wall, chimney and front base; dark tint = the yellow rear base): warm cream-tan faces (GE15), courses 1.7x larger than r1 (2.6 m tile, YE07), near-white stones compressed, deep bed joints (displacement normal x2.6 + displacement AO in _orm.R for Spec.cavity).

timber.notes: Planed stained timber, no board gaps, grain along U (posts use Spec.rot so the grain runs up the post).

tire_rubber.notes: Tyre rubber (sidewalls, tread surface; tread blocks are geometry/normal-baked by the vehicle stream).

trim_paint.notes: Clean semi-gloss white trim paint over smooth wood (fascia, corner boards, casings, rails). Detail only (brush film), no rust, chips or stains.

trim_walnut.notes: Smooth walnut moulding wood (baseboard, crown, casings, chair rail, stair skirt, handrails): no board gaps, grain along U (runs along horizontal trim; rotate for vertical casings).

vinyl_checker_navy.notes: Navy / cream 12 in vinyl checker (green kitchen, refs bo1-materials-kitchen-checkerfloor-crop-01, bo1-interior-kitchen-panorama-01; GI13): flat vinyl class means #3c427e / #d6d4c4, faint jaspé, scratches (light on navy), traffic scuffs + heel marks, per-tile tint, a thin dark seam GROOVE in the normal + AO. Fully procedural (this repo, CC0).

vinyl_seat.notes: Grained vinyl upholstery (car/bus seats, dinette chairs), fully tintable.

wainscot_walnut.notes: Walnut vertical-board wainscot (110 mm boards, V-grooves, satin) for the living rooms / stairwells / back rooms (refs bo1-interior-livingroom-02, bo1-interior-paneled-room-01). Boards cut from a CC0 walnut scan. Map V up the wall; cap with nt_trim_walnut.

wallpaper_floral.notes: Pale sage-cream fruit-vine paper (green kitchen, stairwell, back room; refs bo1-materials-floral-wallpaper-crop-01, bo1-interior-kitchen-panorama-01): the r1 4-vine pattern on a desaturated cream ground (albedo ~#d4cdac, r2 table: kitchen lit #bbb8a3), motifs olive / dusty fruit. Original pattern (CC0) on a CC0 paper scan.

wallpaper_geo_sage.notes: Sage geometric-squares backsplash paper (BO1 yellow kitchen band between the counter and the uppers, refs bo1-interior-kitchen-01): cream double-outlined 94 mm rounded squares alternating with small caramel squares in a cream frame on a 125 mm grid, pale sage ground (#9ca57a..#a6b282). Original pattern (CC0) on a CC0 paper scan.

wallpaper_oval.notes: Mustard interlocking-oval chain paper (BO1 yellow house: entry, stairwell, living, kitchen; refs bo1-interior-livingroom-02, bo1-interior-kitchen-01): 6 mm cream lines on a flat mustard ground, adjacent lines in antiphase pinching into short chain links around 220 x 110 mm horizontal ovals (22 cm repeat). No filled centres, no brick bond (YI03). Original pattern (CC0) on a CC0 paper scan.

wallpaper_star.notes: Pale cream atomic-star paper (green living room / landing, yellow back room; ref bo1-interior-upstairs-room-01): the r0 pattern on a lighter, desaturated ground (albedo ~#ddd09e, r2 table: lit #9c8c60 green / #c3af70-#d2bd7e yellow back room), brown stars kept. Original pattern (CC0) on a CC0 paper scan.

wallpaper_vine.notes: Fine fruit-vine paper (3x the floral density), desaturated to sage-cream (albedo ~#d4ceae). Original pattern (CC0) on a CC0 paper scan.

wood_cabinet.notes: Dark walnut: kitchen cabinets, crown molding, door casings, furniture (LOOK BIBLE 'walnut trim/cabinets').

wood_paneling.notes: Grooved knotty-pine style wall paneling (200 mm boards, V-groove) for the paneled room / wainscot.

wood_pole.notes: Creosote-weathered utility-pole / timber (power poles, pergola posts if stained dark). V along the pole.
